verdict.rationale: Extend's API covers a lot of the platform. That includes every processing endpoint (extract, classify, split, parse, edit), file upload usable for workflows and evaluation-set items, extraction config, deletion APIs for every resource, and webhook setup through either the dashboard or the API. The evidence never claims that everything in the UI is available through the API, and UI-centric features such as Studio versioning, the Composer and Review Agent, and human review are not shown with API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Studio, review and Composer features, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
